item.title: Bulletin updated at 08:50 HKT 28/Oct/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Tropical Cyclone Trami will linger and dissipate gradually over the coast of central Vietnam today. The northeast monsoon will persist over southern China. It will be brighter over the region in the next couple of days. Meanwhile, the broad area of low pressure associated with the remnant of Trami will bring unsettled weather to the central part of the South China Sea. A dry replenishment of the northeast monsoon is expected to affect Guangdong in the middle to latter parts of this week. The weather will be fine and dry over the region. It will be slightly cooler in the morning and at night. The temperature difference between day and night will be relatively large. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Kong-rey will move in the general direction of the seas east of Taiwan in the next couple of days.
